note_normalization: Lowercase; replace each run of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters with a space; trim outer spaces. Match fact text only, within each meeting, against earlier valid structured-note snapshots.
note_repetition_limits: Counts repeated text, including repeated entries with distinct status or evidence; does not measure semantic repetition or correctness.

speaker_consistency.alias_change_count_unit: Segment-label change events across consecutive note-prefix inputs; a segment can be counted more than once. Initial name assignments are distinct from A-D identity reassignments.
limits: Matching consistency is not ground-truth speaker accuracy.
A fixed channel can still mix multiple people or split a person.
Existing notes were not rewritten or rerun; downstream answer impact remains unmeasured.

note_question_example.scoring_method: Source-based Codex review uses the saved request-time correspondence; references remain in AMI labels. No automatic rewriting of all reference answers was implemented.
